# Title

> [!KEY-IDEA] Orientation
> State what this topic explains, why it matters, and its intended scope.

## Current synthesis

Integrate the current understanding. Cite material claims and use explicit epistemic markers where ownership or certainty could be confused.

## Evidence

Represent the strongest supporting and contrary evidence.

## Conflicts and uncertainty

Preserve unresolved disagreements and their consequences. Remove this section when none are material.

## Open questions

Record questions whose answers could change or extend the synthesis.

## Practice
